prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI retry modal redesign concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for modal-open state and page context, not a pixel edit target.
Primary request: Redesign 07-C-03-retry-modal/modal-open.
Direction: focused mode selector with comparison-style options.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. Keep dimmed problem-list context visible and inactive. Center a Snow modal with problem metadata strip, previous attempt summary, three horizontal selectable retry options with short explanations, fixed footer actions, cancel button, and one dark #09090b start CTA.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design Modal, Radio.Group, List, Button mockup; compact app workspace density.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian neutral system; option selected state uses border/weight/icon, not bright color; Obsidian primary CTA only.
Typography: Cosmica-like sans, 14-16px form text, weight-driven hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: preserve modal-open state and retry decision purpose; background list should not compete with the modal; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud gradients, chromatic CTA, oversized rounded bubbles, nested cards inside modal, watermark.
